criteria.finding: Eight runner constructions/import sites and manually reviewed wrappers/dynamic argv plus direct hook subprocess are indexed. Product bytes still match.
criteria.remaining: Scanner is syntactic, not an executable allowlist. Stage B needs typed command requests and explicit supported-operation scope; submodule/signing/filter-process helper requirements have no positive census.

criteria.finding: Ordinary/root/amend hook traces exist; linked/unborn stage+commit and refusal use real daemon RPC on SHA1/SHA256.
criteria.remaining: SEC15 predates GIT6. Amend is a GitRunner probe, not a public operation. No full RPC matrix for ordinary commit message/index edits; linked/unborn hook-edit cases absent.

criteria.criterion: Differential merge, squash, fast-forward and no-worktree target
criteria.finding: Ordinary operations traced. Direct no-checkout merge/squash omit prepare/reference/post phases; installed fallback cannot find git-sh-setup. GIT6 now refuses changed candidate index in ref-only squash.
criteria.remaining: Choose and specify supported no-checkout phases, fallback runtime/dependencies and changed-candidate review. Ordinary merge/squash/FF evidence is low-level; no fresh full RPC edit matrix. Do not equate a bare project with a target ref lacking a checkout.

criteria.criterion: Existing hook refusals and post-success failures accounted for
criteria.finding: Native prepared refusal and late-failure controls recorded; target-specific RPC selection removes ORIG_HEAD masking. Daemon can succeed where native refuses because phases are absent.
criteria.remaining: Specify refusal semantics per supported operation. Retain native positive controls, partial mutation on error and completed-publication status; broad refusal or absent phase is not enforcement acceptance.

criteria.finding: Commit-msg edits propagate in original commit/merge paths and GIT6 RPC control. Native sequencer prepare/commit-msg edits differ from daemon because daemon emits no hooks.
criteria.remaining: Specify phase/message handling for sequencer and no-checkout paths. Current evidence is not authenticated immutable-bundle approval acceptance.

criteria.finding: Original ref-squash loss is historical; GIT6 refuses candidate tree change before publication. Native sequencer staged edits differ from daemon missing phases.
criteria.remaining: Retain GIT6 refusal and file preservation. Define candidate re-review and artifact retention before broker publication. Native merge fixture also omits newly staged pre-merge file; do not impose squash behavior on merge.

criteria.finding: SQLite/safety-ref transitions recorded; SEC25 has 120 graceful restarts with fresh daemon/client, including 48 conflicts. GIT6 retries after explicit refusal preserve failed row.
criteria.remaining: No in-flight crash, power loss, worker cancellation, exactly-once grants or live-worktree publication acceptance. These are stage C/D gates; graceful stop is not crash recovery.

criteria.criterion: All actually invoked hook phases accounted for
criteria.finding: Phase union is indexed from raw traces below. Reference transactions include prepared/committed/aborted and AUTO_MERGE zero-OID cleanup; index and per-file checkout events retained.
criteria.remaining: Trace union is not proof of completeness across all installed hooks/command variants. Fallback sample entry is uninstrumented. Worktree removal/prune, prompt capture/retention-delete, signing and submodule configurations remain unclassified for a supported command contract.

criteria.criterion: Required helper compatibility and native positive controls
criteria.finding: Daemon stage succeeds with WORK bytes instead of CLEAN, restore yields canonical bytes, custom merge preview conflicts; no daemon helper trace.
criteria.remaining: Choose explicit fail-closed unsupported-helper diagnostic or isolated helper implementation before routing. Silent required-filter neutralization is unacceptable under DESIGN; do not add shell/interpreter exceptions.

criteria.criterion: Unusual repository scope and service reachability
criteria.finding: Linked/unborn RPC covered for stage+commit on both formats. Bare project/add rejected in all six cases; bare plumbing evidence is low-level only. Checkpoint restore includes safety capture via service.
criteria.remaining: No standalone checkpoint capture/delete RPC exists; measure actual prompt/retention entrypoints or explicitly exclude them. Bare low-level move_ref is not reproduced through project/add. No universal no-checkout service coverage claim; hostile gitdirs/alternates/config races remain stage B attacks.

decisions.proposal: First isolated worker rejects operations requiring external filters/drivers with a specific unsupported-helper diagnostic; no unfiltered success. Decide supported helpers separately.
decisions.acceptance: Required clean/smudge success/refusal controls; contents and partial-write state asserted through actual service; no host fallback.

decisions.proposal: Publish a finite operation/phase contract for the initial isolated broker. Installed hooks outside supported phases block with a diagnostic; no silent skipping.
decisions.acceptance: Resolve no-checkout prepare/reference/post semantics and fallback dependencies; compare phases/argv/env/stdin and refusal outcomes with native controls.

decisions.proposal: Keep ref-only squash refusal when hooks change the preview candidate; future broker requires review of changed candidate before publication.
decisions.acceptance: GIT6 assertions unchanged; staged/unstaged/untracked/ignored data survives; no claim that temporary index is retained or arbitrary hook side effects rolled back.

decisions.proposal: Record successful publication and post-hook failure separately; never retry mutation automatically on late failure.
decisions.acceptance: Stage C/D journal crash/cancel tests and one-shot persisted grants; existing graceful restarts are insufficient.

decisions.proposal: Bound the first isolated prototype to explicitly enumerated commands in detached candidates. Exclude unsupported command/helper/origin variants explicitly instead of extending census without a gate.
decisions.acceptance: Typed adapter and deny cases for excluded operations; classify prompt capture/retention-delete and removal/prune entrypoints; no production routing.

decisions.proposal: No live-worktree publication from first isolated prototype; retain SEC14 reviewed publication/recovery gate.
decisions.acceptance: Stage D crash injection, concurrent external writes, index/files/ref reconciliation and exact grant consumption.

next_action: Separate bounded stage-A scope/compatibility contract node addressing D-helper, D-phases and D-scope; record explicit exclusions and diagnostics before any stage-B implementation. No new runtime or routing authorized by this ledger.
